title: REBUS: A Robust Evaluation Benchmark of Understanding Symbols
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. The analysis focuses on model performance based on puzzle difficulty, reasoning characteristics (e.g., inexact spelling, specific references), and faithfulness of explanations.

measurement_description: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The benchmark, REBUS, evaluates the performance of multimodal large language models on rebus puzzles, which involve wordplay, image recognition, and multi-step reasoning. One of the 13 puzzle categories is 'Christmas songs', but the evaluation does not assess religious knowledge or bias.
